I'm computing the chi1 dihedral angle for TRP71 by taking the backbone and side-chain coordinates, forming the bond vectors between N-CA, CA-CB, and CB-CG, then calculating cross products to get the normal vectors needed for the dihedral formula.

The magnitude and dot product give an angle around 59.8°, but I still need to determine the correct sign using the triple product with the middle bond vector, which requires computing the cross product of the two normals.
